The 'Some had no solution' card is added and the list repeats it as 'Some tasks have no solution'.

rationale: A dated step list runs beside the diagram all the way through and puts in prose the states the diagram and overlays already show (CTF, no-solution tasks, the crash, the rebuild), which matches the fail anchor.
